the VRS MTA can provide a rapid assessment of medial temporal atrophic changes in the hippocampus, entorhini cortex and perirhinai cortex that is at least as effective in predicting the clinical status of aMCI, AD and CN as HP v.

the use of VRS MTA in conjunction with HP v is an effective approach for the assessment of AD.
